title: Platform Compatibility
description: Two orthogonal platform axes. Compatibility (platform_compat_*): runtime-context checks against the Claris step-compatibility table (fm_spec: step_compat) — NULL in the source is 'Partial', conditionally supported, never 'undocumented'. Platform binding (platform_specific_*): neutral inventory of scripts BUILT FOR a platform — iOS via exclusive steps + dedicated functions, Server via Perform-Script-on-Server context; only these two environments have a binding signal source.
